#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-8;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        double dx = x - other.x;
        double dy = y - other.y;
        return sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    }
    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return fabs(x - other.x) < EPS && fabs(y - other.y) < EPS;
    }
};

struct Line {
    double a, b, c;
    Line() : a(0), b(0), c(0) {}
    Line(const Point& p, double angle) {
        a = sin(angle);
        b = -cos(angle);
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b;
    }
    Line(double a, double b, double c) {
        double h = sqrt(a*a + b*b);
        this->a = a / h;
        this->b = b / h;
        this->c = c / h;
    }
    bool parallel(const Line& other) const {
        return fabs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < EPS;
    }
    Point intersect(const Line& other) const {
        double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
        if (fabs(det) < EPS) return Point(); // parallel, return invalid point? but caller checks
        double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / det;
        double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det;
        return Point(x, y);
    }
    Line perpendicular(const Point& point) const {
        return Line(-b, a, b * point.x - a * point.y);
    }
    double value(const Point& point) const {
        return a * point.x + b * point.y + c;
    }
    double distance(const Point& center) const {
        return fabs(value(center));
    }
    vector<Point> intersect(const struct Circle& circle) const; // forward declaration
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;
    Circle() : center(), radius(0) {}
    Circle(const Point& center, double radius) : center(center), radius(radius) {}
    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double dist = center.distance(other.center);
        if (dist < EPS) return vector<Point>(); // concentric, no intersection
        double a = 2 * (other.center.x - center.x);
        double b = 2 * (other.center.y - center.y);
        double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius + center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x + center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
        Line line(a, b, c);
        return line.intersect(*this);
    }
};

vector<Point> Line::intersect(const Circle& circle) const {
    double dist = distance(circle.center);
    if (dist > circle.radius + EPS) return vector<Point>();
    Point inter = intersect(perpendicular(circle.center));
    if (fabs(dist - circle.radius) < EPS) return vector<Point>{inter};
    double shift = sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
    Point p1(inter.x + shift * b, inter.y - shift * a);
    Point p2(inter.x - shift * b, inter.y + shift * a);
    return vector<Point>{p1, p2};
}

// Union-Find (IndependentSetSystem)
class IndependentSetSystem {
public:
    virtual bool join(int first, int second) = 0;
    virtual int getSetCount() = 0;
    virtual ~IndependentSetSystem() {}
};

class RecursiveIndependentSetSystem : public IndependentSetSystem {
private:
    vector<int> parent;
    vector<int> rank;
    int setCount;
public:
    RecursiveIndependentSetSystem(int size) : parent(size), rank(size, 0), setCount(size) {
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int get(int index) {
        if (parent[index] != index)
            parent[index] = get(parent[index]);
        return parent[index];
    }
    bool join(int first, int second) override {
        first = get(first);
        second = get(second);
        if (first == second) return false;
        if (rank[first] < rank[second]) swap(first, second);
        else if (rank[first] == rank[second]) rank[first]++;
        parent[second] = first;
        setCount--;
        return true;
    }
    int getSetCount() override { return setCount; }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i] >> r[i];
    }
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        circles[i] = Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
    }
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            vector<Point> inter = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (!inter.empty()) {
                for (const Point& p : inter) {
                    points.push_back(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int m = points.size();
    vector<bool> bad(m, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            if (points[i] == points[j]) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    int nVertices = 0;
    for (bool b : bad) if (!b) nVertices++;
    int nEdges = 0;
    RecursiveIndependentSetSystem setSystem(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int current = 0;
        vector<int> onThis;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            if (!bad[j] && fabs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - r[i]) < EPS) {
                current++;
                onThis.push_back(j);
            }
        }
        for (size_t j = 1; j < onThis.size(); ++j) {
            setSystem.join(onThis[j], onThis[0]);
        }
        nEdges += max(current, 1);
    }
    int nComponents = setSystem.getSetCount();
    for (bool b : bad) if (b) nComponents--;
    cout << 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents << endl;
    return 0;
}
